verdict.rationale: Navan publishes a documented public API (OAuth2 client-credentials, retrieval/update endpoints for expenses, cards, custom fields, webhooks) plus a dedicated developer portal and llms.txt, confirming it's built for programmatic/AI-native access; it also ships an official MCP server enabling natural-language querying of Navan data. missing for 10: independent third-party/hands-on verification of API usage beyond vendor docs, and rate-limit/versioning details.
